name: folding-lens
description: Better folding for VSCode: closing brackets in range, readable folded previews

foldingLens.brackets.foldClosing.markdownDescription: Include closing brackets like `}` and `]` in the folding range.

foldingLens.preview.lineCount.markdownDescription: Show the number of folded lines in the collapsed text. Example: `function example() { ⋯ 3 lines ⋯ }`

foldingLens.preview.brackets.markdownDescription: Show brackets like `{` and `}` in the collapsed text. Example: `function example() {…}`. Requires `#foldingLens.brackets.foldClosing#`.

foldingLens.preview.functionParams.markdownDescription: Show parameter names only for explicit multi-line parameter declarations. Calls and unrecognized lists use the basic preview. Requires `#foldingLens.preview.brackets#`.

foldingLens.preview.chaining.markdownDescription: When folding a range, chain ranges that start on the line where it ends. Example: `function example(…) {…}` instead of `function example(…) {`. Requires `#foldingLens.preview.brackets#`.

foldingLens.preview.commentMaxLength.markdownDescription: Maximum length of the complete block comment preview, including its closing marker. Rounded down, with a minimum of 6.

foldingLens.comments.foldable.markdownDescription: Fold closed multi-line /* … */ comments that begin at the first non-whitespace character. Other comments are left to native providers.
